answer:
Use interFoam as the application in system/controlDict.
Create the 2D mesh with blockMesh using a single hex block from (0 0 0) to (0.5 0.5 0.01).
Use 50 cells in the x direction, 50 cells in the y direction, and 1 cell in the z direction.
Set the frontAndBack patches to type empty.
Create left, right, bottom, and top boundaries as walls.
Set the initial and boundary velocity U to noSlip on left, right, bottom, and top.
Set p_rgh to fixedFluxPressure on left, right, bottom, and top.
Set alpha.water to zeroGradient on left, right, bottom, and top.
Set frontAndBack to empty for U, p_rgh, and alpha.water.
Use setFields to initialize alpha.water to 0 everywhere as the default.
Use setFields with a boxToCell region from (0 0 0) to (0.25 0.25 0.01) and set alpha.water to 1 inside that box.
Set the simulation endTime to 5 seconds.
